name: Te Whanga Lagoon
bio: A huge tidal lagoon covering a fifth of Chatham Island, rich in birds and fish.

name: Hapupu National Historic Reserve
bio: A grove of kōpi trees carved by the Moriori, with dendroglyphs of human and bird forms.

name: Pitt Island
bio: A smaller, remote island south-east of the main island, with farmland, cliffs and rare birds.

name: Waitangi
bio: The only town in the Chathams, a small port with a wharf, a pub and a shop.

name: Kōpinga Marae
bio: A Moriori marae that tells the story of the first people of the Chathams.
